shellCommands.command: git status --short; ls -la; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
for f in app/*.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; git log --oneline | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo tsc=$?; timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
git diff tsconfig.json; git checkout -- tsconfig.json; git status --short
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short; git diff app/page.tsx
